mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE menu_tree (menu_name, super_menu_code, menu_code, DEPTH, IS_COLLAPSE, menu_url, navbar_name, order_path) AS ( -- 최상위 메뉴 (Anchor) SELECT menu_name, super_menu_code, menu_code, 1 AS DEPTH, 'Y' AS IS_COLLAPSE, URL as menu_url, NAVBAR_NAME, CAST(menu_code AS VARCHAR(100)) AS order_path FROM menu WHERE super_menu_code IS NULL UNION ALL -- 하위 메뉴 (Recursive) SELECT m.menu_name, m.super_menu_code, m.menu_code, mt.DEPTH + 1, 'N' AS IS_COLLAPSE, m.URL as menu_url, m.NAVBAR_NAME, CAST(CONCAT(mt.order_path, m.menu_code) AS VARCHAR(100)) AS order_path FROM menu m INNER JOIN menu_tree mt ON m.super_menu_code = mt.menu_code ) SELECT menu_name, super_menu_code, menu_code, DEPTH, IS_COLLAPSE, menu_url, navbar_name FROM menu_tree ORDER BY order_path ASC
